_note: Shared worked-example inputs for FMS engineering item 1 (guide docs/61, tools/fmse/*.py, web/fmse1x*.js). All values are EXAMPLES. Every consumer must use exactly these inputs and the formulas in _formulas so the numbers match.

_formulas.irr: r where NPV(r) = 0 (bisection between -0.99 and 1.0, tolerance 1e-7)
_formulas.payback: first year where cumulative undiscounted CF >= I0, linear interpolation inside the year
_formulas.cpm: forward pass ES = max(EF of predecessors), EF = ES + d; backward pass LF = min(LS of successors), LS = LF - d; float = LS - ES; critical = float 0
_formulas.risk_score: score = P * I (1..25); high >= 15, medium 8..14, low <= 7

types.name: FMS (3 HMC + pallet pool + cell controller)

requirements_sample: The system shall machine crankcases VC10, VC20 and VC30 (drawings CC10-D rev C, CC20-D rev D, CC30-D rev B).
Inspection of first parts against drawing (CMM report)
The system shall produce at least 14 crankcases per hour in the product mix 40/35/25 %.
8 h capacity run at FAT and 72 h at SAT, count of good parts
Technical availability caused by the supplier shall be at least 95 % during the 72 h acceptance run.
Bore A diameter 52 H7 shall reach Cpk >= 1.33 over 50 consecutive parts.
CMM measurement of 50 parts, Cpk calculation
The system shall run 8 h unmanned without operator action.
8 h unmanned test run at SAT
Every module shall provide the standard data block (guide 66 section 8) via Modbus TCP.
Read / write test of all words with a Modbus client at FAT
The system shall comply with the EU Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230; safety functions with PL as per risk assessment.
Risk assessment, PL verification report, CE declaration
Documentation in English and the local language: manuals, circuit diagrams (EPLAN PDF + native), PLC sources, spare parts list.
Check of delivered documents against list
